summary: Prepare and run one Fe(110) CH* plus H* coadsorption relaxation as a candidate initial endpoint for CH hydrogenation.

payload.objective: Build, validate, submit, and record one path-compatible Fe45 CH* plus H* coadsorption relaxation on the active production branch.
current_evidence: The user explicitly authorized one Fe(110) CH* plus H* coadsorption run on 2026-08-08.
Local VASP relaxations exist for separate CH*, H*, and CH2* states, but no registered CH* plus H* coadsorbed endpoint exists.
No exact transferable Fe(110) CH* plus H* whitelist structure was identified; local verified structures control construction.
payload.one_executable_step: Select one path-compatible local CH*/H*/CH2* motif, build and audit the coadsorbed POSCAR, prepare production inputs, pass submission gates, and submit one relaxation to sunboquan-codex.
payload.submission_boundary: Authorization covers one Fe(110) CH* plus H* coadsorption relaxation only; it does not authorize NEB, CI-NEB, DIMER, frequencies, endpoint expansion, or resubmission.
done_when: One coadsorbed Fe45 CH* plus H* POSCAR passes composition, constraints, contact, and intended-connectivity checks.
The production input package passes the repository-owned adsorption preflight and backend contract.
Exactly one VASP relaxation is submitted to sunboquan-codex and its scheduler ID, remote path, and provenance are recorded.
